hero.title: Youchang Precision Machinery
hero.subtitle: People-oriented · Quality Service
hero.desc: Dongguan Youchang Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. is a large-scale professional manufacturer of automatic lathes, CNC lathes and computer peripheral equipment. The company originated from Taiwan with three decades of industry history. The China factory is located in Liaobu Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province. Products are widely used in metal, electronics, electrical appliances, watches, instruments, glasses, lighting, sanitary ware, automotive, optoelectronics, fishing gear, locks, probes, connectors, mobile phone accessories, computer accessories, all kinds of screws and other processing areas.
about.title: Company Profile
about.desc1: Youchang Precision Machinery strictly controls product quality from initial development, parts procurement to finished product manufacturing. Every process is strictly executed, with repeated testing and inspection to achieve zero-defect products.
about.desc2: The company adheres to the philosophy of 'People-oriented, quality service', winning the market with integrity and committed to providing quality products and services to customers.
